projects.name: management
details: • Utilized Kafka and MQ to read messages from upstream and persist in our application, ensuring
efficient data processing and storage.
• Backend development to map message flow for database insertion.
• Cross collaboration with product managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to align on development
plan.
• Designed and integrated RESTful Web Services for various applications.
• Root cause analysis and operational support for the products.
• Responsible for writing acceptance test and unit test for the currencies persisted to queue.
• Experience with Agile development methodologies (like Scrum).
• Good working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence.

projects.name: Sales System
details: • Developed multiple modules using spring boot and AngularJS for an application which is used by
Xiaomi store managers and sells personals.
• Services & Controllers development using Spring Boot for the web application.
• Root cause analysis and operational support for the products.
• Owned the delivery of developed modules and features for the web application.
• Cross calibration with Product Managers and Engineers to align on development plan and execution.

projects.name: (Digital Banking Workflow System)
details: • Developed Customer Onboarding and Customer Amendment modules in micro services using Spring
Boot App and Angular6 for building user interface.
• Involved in Writing the Services & Controllers using Spring Boot.
• Used XSLT to transform XML to JSON and vice-versa.
• Responsible for production support, analyzing the root cause of the issue and fixing the issue by
deploying the code in the production environment through business approvals.
• Worked with Geographically distributed team.
Trainee:
• 6 Months of Internship as Java Developer in Profinch Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
